title: BMC Cancer 2025 gastric nerve-related prognostic model G0 audit

publication_goal.approach: Audited imitation and justified adaptation, not copying
publication_goal.success_definition: An evidence-linked manuscript draft with reproducible source tables, figures, methods, and explicit limitations

project_brief.manuscript_goal: Produce a beginner-executable gastric-cancer manuscript by comparing faithful repair, scientifically justified single- or multi-axis adaptation, and evidence-extension routes; do not automatically convert weaknesses in the published NRRS into a construct-audit paper.
project_brief.anchor_use_intent: Use the NRRS paper as a prognostic-model chapter, multi-cohort data index, cross-scale design donor, and negative example for leakage and reporting gaps; do not treat its nerve label, author code, or exact analyzed subsets as ground truth.
project_brief.resource_constraints: Prioritize public bulk, single-cell, and spatial resources plus verified prognostic-model code donors; exact author code and the in-house controlled single-cell cohort are unavailable, so neither may be an indispensable dependency.

scope_policy.optimization_stop_rule: Stop when the minimum implementation needed for manuscript validity, reproducibility, and reviewability is complete
